column2: User-made additions to PeG-WW2 are not as easy to install as the original software, but are not difficult if you read the installation instructions and use a certain amount of common sense - new maps, equipment files and other material ALL have installation instructions (some of which are included with the downloads a n d some of which are on the web sites). It is important to remember that while I am happy to help with any problems - all the information you need is available, you only need to take the time to find and read it. Especially the "Installation of additional maps" section on the campaign page of my website should help if you have problems. You should also consider reading the readme file (under PDF format) of PeG-WW2 game delivered with the installer programme.
column3: 为 PeG-WW2 安装玩家自制内容不像安装原版软件那么容易，但只要你阅读安装说明并运用一定的常识，并不困难——新地图、装备文件和其他资料全都有安装说明（有些随下载一同提供，有些则放在网站上）。重要的是要记住：虽然我很乐意帮忙解决任何问题，但你需要的信息全都找得到，你只需花时间去查找和阅读。如果你遇到问题，尤其应该看看我网站战役页面上的「Installation of additional maps」（安装额外地图）一节，它会有帮助。你也可以考虑阅读安装程序附带的 PeG-WW2 游戏说明文件（PDF 格式）。
